test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who is the author of the book ‘Exam Warriors’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The author of the book ‘Exam Warriors’ is Narendra Modi.
 
• The book was published in the year 2018 and talk about the** young student deal with exam pressure**.
 
• Narendra Modi the Prime Minister of India (as of August 2022) has also written the following books-
 
 
• **Letters to Mother, Jyotipunj and A Journey: Poems**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bibek Debroy has been appointed as the **Chairman of the Economic Advisory Council to PM (EAC-PM)**, as of August 2022.
